findings.description: In the sync wrapper, `copy._local.statistics` is assigned `self._local.statistics` instead of the shared `stats` dict. The async version assigns `stats`, so the two paths are inconsistent.
findings.rationale: Trigger: any call to a function decorated with sync @retry. The copy records its statistics (attempt_number, delay_since_first_attempt, etc.) into its own dict, which is `self._local.statistics`, not `wrapped_f.statistics`. The wrapper's dict is only cleared and then rebound as `self._local.statistics`, so `wrapped_f.statistics` stays empty or stale and the fix for #519 fails. Users reading `f.statistics` after a call see no stats.
